title: SVG Chart Components
desc: Pure React + native SVG, zero dependencies and portable. Props such as title / subtitle / description / actions / legend / loading / onPointClick are uniformly exposed, and every style has a fallback, so it can be copied into another project and used as is.
lineSubtitle: Average Daily Visits over the Last 7 Days
lineDesc: Gradient area fill + stroke draw-in animation; hover to read each day, click to select
barSubtitle: Monthly Output in the First Half of the Year
barDesc: Grows upward from the baseline; click a bar for details
pieDesc: Sectors linked with the legend; hover pulls a sector outward, click selects it
radarDesc: Grid rings + data polygon zoom-in; click a vertex to view that dimension
mlineSubtitle: This Quarter / Last Quarter / Target: three-line comparison
mlineDesc: Multi-series lines with a gradient area fill on the first series; enable showLabel to demo data labels
mbarSubtitle: Three series side by side per month
mbarDesc: Multiple series side by side per category; hover highlights the whole series, click a bar to select
stackSubtitle: Three cumulative series stacked per quarter
stackDesc: Multiple series stacked upward; enable showLabel to show each segment value
mpieSubtitle: Channel share across three regions, side by side
mpieDesc: Several independent pies share one legend; hovering highlights sectors of the same color
npieSubtitle: Click a sector to drill into sub-channels
npieDesc: Drill-down: level-1 sectors by region (with a ▾ hint); clicking switches to that region's sub-channel data, and the back button returns to level 1
dbarSubtitle: Click a bar to drill into monthly data
dbarDesc: Drill-down: level-1 bars by category (with a ▾ hint); clicking switches to that category's monthly data, and the back button returns to level 1
sw1Subtitle: Switch freely between line / bar / pie
sw1Desc: Icon buttons in the top-right switch the view type for the same data; switching replays that chart's entrance animation with consistent colors
sw2Desc: One set of capability-scoring data across four views; supports controlled type/onTypeChange so it can sync with external filters
cardSubtitle: Wraps any chart or custom content
cardDesc: Every chart above is wrapped in ChartCard for its card background; this card shows its use with fully custom content.
footTip: Select a data point for details · "Loading Skeleton" demos the loading state · "Refresh Now" replays the animation · Two-level pie/bar: click level 1 to drill down and back up · SwitchableChart: top-right line/bar/pie/radar icons switch views back and forth with one click
